==Description==
'''Quota Craze''' is an emote that could have been obtained from the [[Hexscape Event#Hexscape Event Battle Pass|Hexscape Event Battle Pass]]. It was made by Capra_K. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. Players can move while performing the emote and it cannot be interacted with.

This emote could be obtained at Level 5 of the premium track, where it costed {{CandyCorns|120 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|40}} ({{Robux|30}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale) to unlock. It had a total cost of {{CandyCorns|370 Candy Corns}} or {{Robux|180}} ({{Robux|144}} for the Black Friday 2024 Sale).

==Trivia==
*'''Quota Craze''' emote originates from ''Lethal Company'' with the store description also referencing it.
*The music that plays when using '''Quota Craze''' is a remix of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S8V5fySc_6o Icecream Song] from ''Lethal Company''.
